title: She Ordered Me To Stock Shelves. I Closed The Aisle.
script: I was inspecting electrical work at a hardware store, wearing an orange safety vest and carrying a clipboard. A customer shoved a box toward me and ordered me to find a cheaper one. I explained that I did not work there. She pointed at the vest and said, Then why are you dressed like that? Before I could answer, she stepped over the caution chain around the aisle I was inspecting. I told her to step back because a ceiling fixture was disconnected. She demanded my manager. Perfect. I called the store manager over, showed him the exposed wiring, and formally closed the aisle until an electrician repaired it. The customer complained that I was refusing service. The manager explained that I was the safety inspector and that crossing the chain had delayed reopening. She stared at my badge for a long second, set down the box, and left. The aisle reopened an hour later. Her discount search took slightly longer.
